verdict.rationale: Ellis Porter is an immigration law firm offering attorney-led legal services. A downloadable machine-readable API spec is outside what buyers comparing law firms would reasonably ask for, so this axis does not apply. Its client portal is a document and communication tool with no documented API, and the probe found no OpenAPI files at any of the candidate paths.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
